results.title: Inky Pinky Ponky 2
results.overview: Follows Lisa, a successful designer returning for a school reunion, exploring themes of identity, family acceptance, romance with a rugby player, and personal growth within a Tongan-New Zealand community.

results.title: Bury the Devil
results.overview: When a hospice nurse finds herself trapped with a dementia patient, she begins to suspect something else is wrong with the woman, something otherworldly, and must fight to survive the night.

results.title: Faces of Death
results.overview: A moderator on an internet video-sharing platform stumbles across a potential snuff film ring hidden in the depths of the site's content.

results.title: Pizza Movie
results.overview: A group of college students go downstairs to their dorm lobby to get a delivery pizza. There's only one issue: They're insanely high on a homemade drug, turning their simple journey down two sets of stairs into a mind-bendingly transformative quest.

results.title: The Last Temptation of Becky
results.overview: Now working as a field agent for the CIA, Becky is sent undercover to Poland to infiltrate a family of innkeepers running a tourist venture at The Wolf's Lair, Hitler's WWII bunker. After learning that the father, Wilhelm Reuss, is on a mission to bring about the Fourth Reich, Becky takes matters into her own hands.

results.title: Coward
results.overview: Surrounded by brutality but bound by tenderness, two World War I soldiers find a fragile sanctuary of love and art amid the shadows of the Belgian trenches.

results.title: Gatta Kusthi 2
results.overview: Picks up after the first film, with Veera and Keerthi balancing parenthood and Keerthi's wrestling career, featuring a role reversal where Veera takes on more domestic responsibilities.

results.title: Moulin
results.overview: In June 1943, Jean Moulin, leader of the French Resistance, is arrested while attempting to reunite the forces of the "Armée Secrète." Interrogated by Klaus Barbie, the head of the Gestapo in Lyon, Moulin is drawn into a relentless confrontation.

results.title: Lockbox
results.overview: A woman puts her life on the line to protect her troubled and enigmatic cousin, who has been targeted and hunted by a powerful supernatural force.

results.title: It's My Time
results.overview: At the age of seventy, a fiercely non-conformist grandmother partners with a lethargic, underachieving young prodigy to navigate the highly competitive and eccentric subculture of speedcubing, defying familial skepticism and generational expectations.

results.title: Wings of Dread
results.overview: Air police officer Gu Chaoyang encounters a hijacking crisis on his flight back to China. With his extremely high professional ethics, he fights desperately to stop the hijacker, and a life-and-death struggle that takes place at an altitude of ten thousand meters begins.

results.title: Dhoomakethu
results.overview: On the morning of his wedding, 36-year-old Kuttan wakes from a disturbing dream about his own death. As the day unfolds, familiar moments begin to repeat, and reality becomes increasingly difficult to distinguish from memory. Realising that something is terribly wrong, Kuttan races to uncover the truth before the day repeats itself.

results.title: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM HATHAWAY The Sorcery of Nymph Circe
results.original_title: 機動戦士ガンダム  閃光のハサウェイ キルケーの魔女
results.overview: Haunted by his past, Hathaway Noa is drawn to Gigi Andalucia, a mysterious girl whose strange abilities stir memories within him. As he prepares his attack on the Adelaide Conference, Federation officer Kenneth Sleg readies the defense. With each man pursuing his own goal, Gigi heads to Hong Kong to fulfill a role of her own.

results.title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
results.original_title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
results.overview: It's a matter of life and death for Alison, Mike, Mia and the Ghosts.

results.title: Torrente for President
results.overview: Years have passed since his last adventure, but José Luis Torrente, the most politically incorrect former cop in Spain, still sees himself as a national hero.

results.title: Ladies First
results.overview: An arrogant but charismatic ladies' man finds his life of money, power and casual flings upended when he wakes up in a parallel world dominated by women.

results.title: Seriously Single Too
results.overview: Dineo and Noni — besties meant to take on the party scene together — suddenly face their biggest fear when Noni's boyfriend spontaneously propose.

results.title: A Better Jianghu
results.overview: Two individuals, the scholar Shen Fang and the knight-errant Luo Han, steal a huge sum of silver from the official Qin Hui to support the anti-Jin rebels, devising a grand deception to combat the imperial guard and rally people from all walks of life to their cause during the Southern Song Dynasty.
